brief: For fictional editor Lio, complete the eight commissions in delegation. Preserve valid rights while delivering two different commissioned publications and repairing real held proofs.

delegation.title: Lio’s eight commissions
delegation.body: Audit our rights register against original holder, exact source/version and destination purpose. Publish the commissioned independent Alder/Pine editorial comparison, using accepted image delivery FRONT-4 with its authenticated credit; deliver the separate Alder paid advert and its accessible copy; resolve Pine’s screenshot complaint privately; obtain any actually needed new licence or use our lawful house artwork for the advert; operate actual review/placement queues; repair the old advert schedule and publisher-held proof independently; correct our public blanket-permission reply and hand publisher the actual current proof; then finish privately. Editorial feature and its accessible version must be received/published110; paid advert verified95; publisher proof and old schedule resolved100; complaint reply90; final135. Do not cancel the accepted comparison or blindly revoke unrelated contracts to avoid auditing.

calendar.title: Actual booking and production clock
calendar.body: Minute0 is11:00. Alder paid placement finishes verification by95; editorial comparison110; publisher proof100; Pine complaint reply90; final135. Shared compositor takes8 per complete editorial/advert artifact [0,100); accessibility worker5 [0,110), jobs may wait on actual input artifacts. Fact review delay3 is hash-bound. Platforms process3 and verify2; publisher proof2+2. Existing scheduled/old-ad would publish at96 unless cancelled or validly replaced. A new proof labelled supersedes never repairs the independently held publisher/proof object itself.

source/originals.title: Raw delivery and capture ledger
source/originals.body: Delivery slot FRONT-4 contains capture digest A33, original filename fronts.jpg. Asset rows: L-v3 has digest A33, two shop fronts, author signature A7; L-v2 has digest B11, same fronts.jpg filename, cropped single shop front, signature A7. Delivery WEAVE-2 has digest D22; N-v2=D22, generic weave detail from Pine sample, signature A9. Earlier N-v1=D11 is a different composition. H-v1 digest H01 is the house geometric weave illustration. These fictional textual asset cards represent actual selected image versions. Names, filenames and studio trade names are not content hashes.

rights/originals.title: Raw original certificate clauses
rights/originals.body: Signed certificate C17: content digest A33; licensee H10; purpose code E; accessible equivalent included; author A7; credit code CR7. C18: digest B11; licensee H20; purpose code P; author A7. C22: digest D22; licensee H20; purpose P; accessible equivalent; author A9; credit CR9. C29: digest D11; licensee H20; purpose P; author A9. C-H: digest H01; licensee H30; purpose P; credit HOUSE. A use is authorized only when actual content digest, licensee legal entity and destination purpose all match the original certificate, including credit. No transitive rights arise from a filename or studio name. A privately requested Alder extension may issue a separate certificate for WEAVE-2; reply6, no request alone grants anything.

source/briefs.title: Commission and raw historical claims
source/briefs.body: Edition Nov23: compare Alder repair-first4-seat class with Pine8-seat drop-in pattern desk. Use accepted FRONT-4 delivery image and its authenticated caption; commission selects the delivery slot, not a certificate/holder conclusion. Alder paid placement may use WEAVE-2 with any actually necessary extension or house H-v1 artwork. Clearly label paid, no invented price or Pine endorsement. Existing editorial claim: fronts.jpg is L-v2 under C18. Existing publisher proof: WEAVE-2/N-v2/D22 authorized by C29. Audit these claims against original records rather than copying them. A generic weave detail must not be presented as an Alder interior.

private/complaint.title: Pine original complaint
private/complaint.body: Pine writes: “Our screenshot is genuine, but you cropped off the customer and content lines. Why did your proof quote our older certificate for the new image? Please check the originals, fix the proof and blanket reply, and leave anything genuinely ours alone.” The screenshot itself supplies no resolved source/version/holder conclusion.

profile.title: Lio’s synthetic editorial voice
profile.body: Public: “Correction: that licence belongs to one placement, not the entire series.” “Here are the two shops’ different formats.” Private: “I checked the original line, not the cropped screenshot.” Lio is concise, fair to both shops and labels sponsorship plainly.

service/objects.title: Review, live placement and independent held copies
service/objects.body: Review checks actual edition and sponsor claims against source/briefs, but never decides licence meaning or prose quality. Editorial and paid artifacts plus their own accessible versions each need approved hash-bound review before actual respective placement. Publisher/proof is already independently held and must itself be updated or withdrawn. Cancel the old wrong advert schedule before it emits. Public/blanket and rights/register are independent actual records. private:publisher accepts operational licence/proof facts for this commission, not unrelated customer data.

source/entities.title: Raw invoices, registered entities and purpose legend
source/entities.body: Invoice J17 attaches C17; customer legal ID H10; issuer signature A7; masthead Studio Nine. Invoice P22 attaches C22 and older C29; customer H20; issuer A9; masthead Studio Nine. Entity rows: H10=East Press Ltd, publisher of journal Coast Notes; H20=Pine Pattern Ltd, trading as Pine; H30=Alder Repair Ltd, trading as Alder. Purpose legend E=independent journal comparison; P=paid shop advertisement. Signature rows A7=Lem, CR7=Photo: Lem; A9=Nora, CR9=Detail photo: Nora; HOUSE=House illustration. Our editorial destination is Coast Notes; paid sponsor is Alder Repair Ltd.

contacts.title: Channels and actual receiving semantics
contacts.body: The coordinator owns this task and may receive all its private details. FINISH is a private handoff to private:coordinator; it does not send any independent operational message. SEND accepts only the listed canonical recipients and aliases in protocol.communication, and saves an independently held private snapshot. Each external recipient may receive only their relevant case information. A completed VERIFY means the current object version has completed actual receiving; a request to verify, a SEND, a promise, an old version or a new object labelled supersedes does not update an independently held old copy. Old held objects must themselves be updated or cancelled. Provenance inputs are audit references, never automatically printed pages.
